description: Handles inbound patient calls: answers FAQs from knowledge base, books/reschedules/cancels appointments on Google Calendar, and transfers to a human when the query requires clinical judgment, billing disputes, or falls outside its scope. Maintains a warm, professional, and empathetic healthcare tone throughout.
note: Voice agents use WebSocket-based real-time audio streaming. No JSON response schema is applied to voice output. The agent responds with spoken audio directly to the caller.
